messages.subject: Project Falcon — completion accounts query
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

Quick one on Project Falcon (the Greaves Precision acquisition) rather than anything new: the accountants have flagged a £40k working-capital adjustment in the draft completion accounts. Could Mark forward the December creditors ledger so we can reconcile before we respond to Castle & Vane? Nothing urgent — early next week is fine.

James
